text: Morphologic-abnormality concepts are used as clinical_finding subjects: Eruption, Lesion@Anal structure and Pseudomembrane@Nasal/Pharyngeal structure. Eruption is redundant with Skin lesion. The finding_site forms rely on body-site resolution that VHA's test does not verify.

ref: Diagnose probable tick bite fever / Diagnose probable acute viral infection
text: The flowchart entry gate ('if none of the above, or previous malaria test/s negative') is not represented, so these probable rules can fire alongside possible mpox, diphtheria or malaria. This is acceptable as flowchart routing.

ref: Check for causes of fever not needing urgent attention
text: Two page instructions in this section have no rule at all: 'If patient has been in a malaria area in past 3 months, consider malaria' (p38-2d9a1b25) should give a possible Malaria diagnosis with a travel/exposure check, and 'If on abacavir, check for abacavir hypersensitivity reaction' (p38-2172e4f3) is not checked for. Also, the page scopes this section to patients not needing urgent attention and (for the tick/viral branch) 'none of the above'; the task triggers on any fever, which is a tolerable simplification but should be recorded.

ref: Urgent: fever with red-box danger signs
text: Urgent is justified by 'Give urgent attention' and the (and fever (or ...)) structure, with meningitis/appendicitis via active_condition, follows the house standard. Gap: footnote 1 (p38-d50f2820) says 'If SBP < 80, pulse >= 100, respiratory rate > 30, confusion/restlessness, weakness, shock likely' - an 'X likely' on the page with no probable Shock diagnosis rule; the priority rule only matches a recorded Shock finding or SBP < 80, so a febrile patient with pulse >= 100 + RR > 30 + confusion (no BP reading) is not escalated by this page.
check_for omits respiratory rate >= 30 and systolic BP < 80, which are red-box items (they appear only in the priority rule).

ref: Diagnose possible mpox from fever page
text: Page requires an UNEXPLAINED rash/lesion plus at least one symptom; unexplained is dropped. Also this non-urgent branch is not gated by absence of red-box signs.

ref: Diagnose possible diphtheria from fever page
text: Pseudomembrane must bleed easily if touched (dropped); also fever is mild on the page while the rule accepts any fever.

Page says if in a malaria area in past 3 months, consider malaria (p39); no possible-malaria rule exists. Travel history may be unencodable. Also not encoded: glucose < 3 (< 4 diabetes) or >= 11.1 refer step, abacavir hypersensitivity check.

ref: Check for causes of fever not needing urgent attention
text: Nothing invented, but the page's 'malaria area in past 3 months, consider malaria' and 'If on abacavir, check for AHR' have no checked finding and no rule; the diphtheria pseudomembrane drops 'bleeds easily if touched'.

'Likely' maps to probable and the evidence is right, but the diagnosis concept is too narrow: South African tick-bite fever (Boutonneuse/R. conorii) excludes African tick bite fever. Use Spotted fever group rickettsial disease. The page's gate ('if none of the above, or previous malaria test/s negative') is not encoded.
